about: Per-package compatibility with newer FM-1s (flash chip 0xB36014). Anything not listed, or marked unknown, is untested. Rewritten by scripts/update-newchip.py.

source.name: The Firmware Hub
source.attribution: Firmware list: The Firmware Hub – https://thefirmwarehub.com

meaning.works: hub chip=new: the package knows the newer flash chip, so it saves and can update there
meaning.bricks: hub chip=old: the package knows only the first units' chip; on a newer FM-1 it keeps saves in RAM and often refuses updates
meaning.unknown: hub chip=any (or no data): not checked or not tried on the newer chip. Never treated as safe

firmwares.name: FM-1 V15
firmwares.source: https://thefirmwarehub.com/tools/rescue/ ("Which chip is in yours?": a newer FM-1 loses saves "while M-VAVE's V15 keeps them"). The hub also offers V15 as the way back on newer units.
